Rachel,

Per your request, our clearing desk confirms the likely intermediary routing for USD/EUR via Continental Correspondent Bank (CCB) BIC: CCBGB2L. Typical intermediary charges for this corridor are in the range of €8-€35 depending on chain length and any pass-through fees.

Important: selecting "OUR" instructs sending bank to cover all charges but does not eliminate downstream correspondent fees that may be levied before credit — the sending bank's price schedule determines how much they pass on. If the originator selects "SHA", the originator will pay their bank fees and any intermediary deductions will be taken from the payment amount.

We cannot provide guarantees on your reclaiming any intermediary deductions; clients usually handle this by instructing OUR when they must ensure a specific net credit.

Regards,
